decision.resolvedP2: Unfiltered producer boundary in public restore report

reviewedBehavior.publicAllowlist: Fixed typed hashes, date, two known qualification enums, false fresh/same-job flags, typed completion counts/booleans, and separately validated fixed-origin/current-execution replay metadata.
reviewedBehavior.excluded: Raw archive/dep-info paths, original stage arrays, lastActivity, opaque identities/tags, arbitrary features/logs/measurements and unknown fields are not copied.
reviewedBehavior.unknown: Optional unknown fields are omitted. Required status/count/completion data must be proven and typed; None/bool-as-zero/float-as-zero are rejected, not replaced by zero.
reviewedBehavior.validation: Projection follows successful original restore. It does not replace manifest/context/identity/payload/mode/mtime/effective-config validation or modify private inputs.
reviewedBehavior.primaryFailure: Projection failure gets checkpoint-restore-public-evidence attribution and blocks continuation; an original restore failure prevents invocation and remains first failure.
reviewedBehavior.compatibility: Pure Python return-value projection with no new native API, process, resource, archive or restore behavior; a further Mac run solely for projection is unnecessary after the already-required real restore gate succeeds.

negativeCoverage: Nested private sentinels, stage names, measurements, paths and tags omitted
Every required stage field and single required stage occurrence
Exact replay schema/origin/real current environment binding
Input and environment mutation or aliasing prevented
Projection error stops pipeline with correct phase
Original restore error remains primary and never invokes projection
Full tiny archive restore feeds the actual projector with exact final state validation

limits: Short46 actual stored-checkpoint restore and effective configuration must still pass terminal review.
This source-delta review does not certify a new caller or provider commit until separately read back.
Existing public CI log output and curated repository evidence are distinct. Standard Mac paths previously output are not evidence of a secret leak; this change prevents future redundant projection.
Full host/XUL and native authentication remain unverified.
